Is everyone excited for Thursday's Latin Grammys and Monday's American Grammy Nominations announcement? I have some fun facts and one not-so-fun fact.
 Let's get the sad one out of the way. The Warning's one category nomination, Best Rock Song for Ego, is not part of the regular Univision TV broadcast. Like almost all award shows, there are those given away on the television program and others at a non-televised ceremony earlier in the afternoon. Of the 60 categories, only 15 are on the broadcast. However, do not fret. The non-televised ceremony will be streamed on the Latin Grammy's Official YouTube, Facebook, and website at NOON Pacific time.
 They ARE performing in the ceremony, but the award will already have been given out.
